# Taskbar Fighters

> Pixel-art fighters on the Windows 11 taskbar, one per AI coding program in use (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, Cursor, Ollama, LM Studio, Copilot CLI and more). At most two fight at a time, driven by what those programs are really doing (working, idle, waiting, sleeping, context %). Python 3.12+ and Pillow; Windows 11 (tested) and macOS 13+ (experimental, untested on real hardware: PyObjC, fighters on the Dock, docs/MAC-TESTING.md); no network; reads only numbers and states from local transcripts and the process list. The command-line tool is `minis.py` ("minis" is the internal short name).

To install it for a user, follow AGENTS.md: preflight, `git clone https://github.com/mrktchris/taskbar-fighters`, `python -m pip install -r requirements.txt`, `python -m unittest discover -s tests`, `python minis.py start`, `python minis.py status`. On a Mac: `./scripts/setup_mac.sh` (creates .venv, installs requirements-mac.txt, runs `python minis.py doctor`). Ask the user before adding any startup entry. Never edit the user's AI tool settings or hooks.

## Docs

- [README.md](https://github.com/mrktchris/taskbar-fighters/blob/master/README.md): what it does, features, every command, right-click menu, configuration, privacy and safety, how it works, known limits
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/mrktchris/taskbar-fighters/blob/master/AGENTS.md): agent install runbook, rules, troubleshooting, how to add a program or a character
- [MOVELIST.md](https://github.com/mrktchris/taskbar-fighters/blob/master/MOVELIST.md): every move, trigger and timing (generated)
- [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/mrktchris/taskbar-fighters/blob/master/CHANGELOG.md): V1 to V6
- [docs/MAC-TESTING.md](https://github.com/mrktchris/taskbar-fighters/blob/master/docs/MAC-TESTING.md): macOS install, the checklist to verify it on a real Mac, known risks
- [RESULT.md](https://github.com/mrktchris/taskbar-fighters/blob/master/RESULT.md): build logs with what was verified and how

## Key files

- [minis.py](https://github.com/mrktchris/taskbar-fighters/blob/master/minis.py): CLI, director loop, fighter loop
- [minis_core/sources.py](https://github.com/mrktchris/taskbar-fighters/blob/master/minis_core/sources.py): program detection table (add a program here)
- [minis_platform/__init__.py](https://github.com/mrktchris/taskbar-fighters/blob/master/minis_platform/__init__.py): picks the Windows (minis_win) or macOS (minis_mac) backend
- [minis_core/config.py](https://github.com/mrktchris/taskbar-fighters/blob/master/minis_core/config.py): every setting and its default (`minis.json` overrides)
- [minis_core/director.py](https://github.com/mrktchris/taskbar-fighters/blob/master/minis_core/director.py): which two programs get a fighter
- [art/roster.py](https://github.com/mrktchris/taskbar-fighters/blob/master/art/roster.py): the 13 characters (add a character here, then `python art/build_fighters.py --all --only <name>`)
